description: The plot illustrates how coverage changes as the number of completions \(k\) increases for four model conditions (Llama-3B, Llama-3B + FT, Llama-1B, and Llama-1B + FT). The x-axis is labeled “Number of completions (\(k\))” and uses a logarithmic base-2 scale with tick labels from \(2^0\) through \(2^8\) (i.e., \(k=1\) to \(k=256\)) at every power of two. The y-axis is labeled “Coverage” on a linear scale, spanning roughly from about 0.2 up to about 0.9 with major ticks shown at 0.4, 0.6, and 0.8. The Llama-3B line is dark blue with circular markers and a solid line, rising from about 0.43 at \(2^0\) to about 0.88 at \(2^8\), increasing steadily with intermediate points around 0.62 at \(2^2\) and about 0.80 at \(2^5\). The Llama-3B + FT line is green with triangular markers and a dotted line, starting near 0.44 at \(2^0\) and ending near 0.88 at \(2^8\), with values around 0.63 at \(2^2\) and about 0.81 at \(2^5\). The Llama-1B line is light blue with circular markers and a solid line, increasing from about 0.25 at \(2^0\) to about 0.84 at \(2^8\), passing through roughly 0.45 at \(2^2\) and about 0.74 at \(2^5\). The Llama-1B + FT line is light green with triangular markers and a dotted line, rising from about 0.26 at \(2^0\) to about 0.86 at \(2^8\), with intermediate values near 0.46 at \(2^2\) and about 0.76 at \(2^5\).
